d:
'Jab Mila Tu' from 'I Hate Luv Storys' showcases Imran Khan sharing some fun moments with Sonam Kapoor on the sets of their movie project. Their chemistry is immaculate and their budding love story is scintillating, this video will surely bring a smile on your face. This song features Vishal Dadlanis voice, and the movie's music is directed by Vishal and Shekhar.'I Hate Luv Storys' is a Bollywood romantic comedy made in 2010, directed by Punit Malhotra.
Song Name - Jab Mila Tu
Movie - I Hate Luv Storys
Singer - Vishal Dadlani
Composer - Vishal Dadlani and Shekhar Ravjiani
